name: Chao Meifan
source:
[A Proud Sow Who Trusts No One]

Her parents run a restaurant that's featured in guidebooks. Although her parents are Chinese, she was born and raised in Japan, so she's not that great at Chinese. 

Having been bullied in the past, she's developed a stubborn personality that refuses to show any weakness.

[From [url=https://www.parallel-soft.net/poison/products/himei/chara10.html]official site[/url]]
